faq_heading: Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows schools: your questions answered

blocks.text: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list shows 38 schools with a Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows street address: 33 public schools and 5 independent schools. In that list, 7 schools marked as offering French Immersion, 2 alternate programs and 1 online school.
Public schools here are run by School District 42 (Maple Ridge-Pitt Meadows). Count by district: School District 42 (Maple Ridge-Pitt Meadows): 33.
Alternate programs, continuing education centres and online schools that have a street address sit under "other public schools and programs"; the level of every school is read from its name.
By mailing community, the Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows list splits as Maple Ridge (33) and Pitt Meadows (5).

Public secondary schools with a Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows address: District 42 Alternative Secondary, Garibaldi Secondary, Maple Ridge Secondary, Outreach Alternate Secondary, Pitt Meadows Secondary, Samuel Robertson Technical Secondary, Thomas Haney Secondary and Westview Secondary.

The Ministry file marks these Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows schools as offering French Immersion: Eric Langton Elementary, Golden Ears Elementary, Laity View Elementary, Maple Ridge Elementary, Maple Ridge Secondary, Pitt Meadows Elementary and Pitt Meadows Secondary.
Independent schools listed for Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows include James Cameron School, Maple Ridge Christian School, Meadow Montessori, Meadowridge School and St Patrick's.
Before an offer, ask the district which school serves the exact street address.
Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows are separate cities served by one school district, so they share this list and the Community column shows which city each school is in.

faq.q: How many schools are in Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows, BC?
faq.a: The BC Ministry of Education and Child Care list shows 38 schools with a Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows street address: 33 public schools and 5 independent schools. The count includes alternate programs and online schools that have a street address.

faq.q: Which school district covers Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows?
faq.a: Public schools with a Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows address are run by School District 42 (Maple Ridge-Pitt Meadows).

faq.q: How do I find the catchment school for a Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows address?
faq.a: Ask School District 42 (Maple Ridge-Pitt Meadows) to confirm it for the exact street address.
